place.source_title: Union Block (Crystal Ballroom), Church Street and 4th Street

brief: Three-storey Venetian Gothic brick block of 1902-04: buff brick with an arcaded loggia of pointed arches at the centre, patterned brick bands, a corbelled cornice, and a lodge ballroom on the top floor; a brewpub and shops at street level.

facade.notes: the Union Block (Newark OH, 1904), detail: a buff-brick Venetian Gothic front -- a three-part loggia of ogee arches on stone columns with an iron balcony, lancet windows with stone hoods, quoined corners, an ornate pressed-metal arcaded cornice; a ballroom upstairs; a club's signs below

why.note: a ballroom's loggia over the street
